characters.name: Lorenzo de' Medici
characters.title: Il Magnifico
characters.description: The golden prince of Florence. Banker, poet, patron of Botticelli and Leonardo. His wealth buys loyalty — but art is expensive, and every florin spent on beauty is one not spent on survival.

perk.name: Patron of the arts
perk.description: Influence loss is halved — cultural prestige cushions political blows

downside.name: Gilded cage
downside.description: Wealth decays -3 per round from lavish spending on art and patronage

characters.name: Cosimo de' Medici
characters.title: Pater Patriae
characters.description: The elder Medici who built the dynasty from a counting house. He rules Florence without a title, through loans, favors, and quiet leverage. But a banker without an army is a man holding gold in a room full of swords.

perk.name: Gold speaks
perk.description: Can spend wealth to boost any stat by +10, once per game

downside.name: Unarmed banker
downside.description: Military gains are halved — no martial tradition

characters.name: Pope Alexander VI
characters.title: Rodrigo Borgia
characters.description: The most infamous pope in history. He bought the papacy, fathered children openly, and wielded the Church like a weapon. The tiara protects him — but the Borgia name poisons everything it touches.

perk.name: Vicar of Christ
perk.description: Church standing cannot drop below 30 — papal immunity

downside.name: Borgia stench
downside.description: Influence gains are halved — everyone distrusts a Borgia pope

characters.name: Francesco Sforza
characters.title: Duke of Milan
characters.description: A mercenary who married into power and seized Milan's throne. His sword arm is legendary, but the Church sees him as a godless adventurer, and every year the priests whisper louder.

perk.name: Condottiere's blade
perk.description: Military scenarios give double stat gains

downside.name: Mercenary blood
downside.description: Church standing decays -2 per round — seen as a godless sword-for-hire

characters.name: Pope Julius II
characters.title: The Warrior Pope
characters.description: He commissioned the Sistine Chapel ceiling and personally led armies into battle. A pope in armor, terrifying in his wrath. But his famous temper turns misfortune into catastrophe.

perk.name: Warrior pope
perk.description: Military and church gains don't conflict — unique among popes

downside.name: Terribilita
downside.description: Luck rolls below 5 hit twice as hard — his temper makes bad luck worse

characters.name: Ludovico Sforza
characters.title: Il Moro
characters.description: The puppet master of Milan who invited the French into Italy to settle a personal grudge — and accidentally started decades of foreign invasion. A brilliant schemer undone by his own schemes.

perk.name: Milan's puppeteer
perk.description: Political scenarios give +5 bonus influence

downside.name: Invited the French
downside.description: Crisis events hit with 1.5x severity — his scheming always backfires

characters.name: Pope Leo X
characters.title: Giovanni de' Medici
characters.description: A Medici on the papal throne. He famously declared 'Since God has given us the papacy, let us enjoy it.' He merged Medici gold with papal authority — but never held a sword in his life.

perk.name: Medici pontiff
perk.description: Wealth and church boost each other — +3 to the lower when either gains

downside.name: Indulgence seller
downside.description: Military locked at starting value — no martial instinct whatsoever

characters.name: Cesare Borgia
characters.title: Il Valentino
characters.description: Machiavelli's model prince. Cardinal turned general, he carved out a kingdom in the Romagna with brilliance and brutality. But everything depends on his father the Pope — and popes do not live forever.

perk.name: Il Valentino
perk.description: Military gains doubled — brilliant general

downside.name: Father's shadow
downside.description: When church standing drops below 40, all stats decay -2 per round — loses papal backing

characters.name: Filippo Strozzi
characters.title: The Rival Banker
characters.description: Head of Florence's second banking dynasty. Richer than most kings, but forever in the Medici's shadow. No matter how much gold he piles up, the ceiling of Florentine power has a Medici seal on it.

perk.name: Rival fortune
perk.description: Economic scenarios give double wealth gains

downside.name: Medici's shadow
downside.description: Influence capped at 65 — always second to the Medici in Florence

characters.name: Federico da Montefeltro
characters.title: Duke of Urbino
characters.description: The ideal Renaissance man — scholar, art collector, and undefeated general. But Urbino is tiny, and even a perfect duke of a small duchy cannot match the resources of Florence or Milan.

perk.name: Scholar-soldier
perk.description: Negative luck rolls on military scenarios are negated — tactical genius

downside.name: Small duchy
downside.description: Wealth and influence gains reduced by 25% — Urbino lacks Florence's resources

characters.name: Lucrezia Borgia
characters.title: Duchess of Ferrara
characters.description: Pawn of her father and brother, married three times for political gain. But she learned from every marriage, every betrayal. She plays the game through alliances others can't see — though the Borgia name follows her like a curse.

perk.name: Dynastic pawn
perk.description: Political scenarios offer a secret 4th choice — marriage alliance

downside.name: Borgia reputation
downside.description: Church standing gains halved, and any scandal event doubles its penalty

characters.name: Bartolomeo Colleoni
characters.title: Captain-General of Venice
characters.description: The most feared mercenary commander in Italy, paid a fortune by Venice to never actually fight — his reputation alone kept enemies at bay. But a man defined by war has no friends in peacetime.

perk.name: Venice's sword
perk.description: Military ceiling raised to 95 — tolerated as champion of the Republic

downside.name: Hired blade
downside.description: Influence and church standing decay -2 each per round — a mercenary has no true allies

characters.name: Pope Sixtus IV
characters.title: The Conspirator Pope
characters.description: Builder of the Sistine Chapel and architect of the Pazzi conspiracy. He gave his nephews everything — cardinalships, armies, cities. But nepotism is a tower built on sand, and when ambition outpaces piety, even a pope can fall.

perk.name: Nepotist supreme
perk.description: Can redirect negative stat changes to a different stat, once per 3 rounds

downside.name: Pazzi conspirator
downside.description: If influence ever exceeds church standing, both drop by 10 — political overreach exposes him

characters.name: Isabella d'Este
characters.title: First Lady of the Renaissance
characters.description: Marchioness of Mantua, diplomat, and the most cultured woman in Europe. Kings sought her counsel, artists begged her patronage. But Mantua is a speck on the map, and charm cannot conjure armies.

perk.name: First lady of the Renaissance
perk.description: Luck rolls of 9+ grant +5 to all stats — cultural magnetism

downside.name: Mantua's limits
downside.description: Military locked below 30 — tiny state, no army to command

characters.name: Niccolo Machiavelli
characters.title: The Secretary
characters.description: A bureaucrat who saw everything and understood more than any prince. He wrote the book on power — literally — but never held any himself. The sharpest mind in Italy, trapped in the weakest position.

perk.name: The advisor
perk.description: Sees the luck roll before choosing — information is power

downside.name: No prince of his own
downside.description: All stat gains capped at +8 per round — a secretary, not a ruler

characters.name: Girolamo Savonarola
characters.title: The Prophet of Florence
characters.description: A Dominican friar who overthrew the Medici with nothing but sermons. He burned the vanities of Florence and terrified a pope. But zealots make enemies of everyone, and fire eventually consumes the one who lit it.

perk.name: Bonfire of vanities
perk.description: Can sacrifice wealth to gain church standing at 2:1 ratio

downside.name: Fanatic's hubris
downside.description: If church standing exceeds 80, influence drops by 5 per round — people fear the zealot

characters.name: Caterina Sforza
characters.title: The Tigress of Forli
characters.description: When assassins killed her husband and seized her children, she stood on the castle walls and dared them to do their worst. She has survived everything Italy has thrown at her — but survival is not the same as victory.

perk.name: The tigress
perk.description: Survives one death/exile trigger per game — historically unkillable defiance

downside.name: Surrounded
downside.description: Crisis events always target her, and all negative stat changes are +3 worse

characters.name: Jacopo de' Pazzi
characters.title: Head of the Pazzi
characters.description: The patriarch of Florence's most ambitious also-rans. The Pazzi have the gold but not the glory. One grand conspiracy could change everything — or end everything. There is no middle ground for a man this desperate.

perk.name: Conspiracy
perk.description: Once per game, attempt a coup: luck roll 8+ steals 20 influence; below 8 loses 20

downside.name: Medici's enemy
downside.description: Permanent -3 per round influence decay — marked man in Florence

characters.name: Giovanni delle Bande Nere
characters.title: The Last Condottiere
characters.description: The last great Italian mercenary captain in an age when foreign armies had made Italian warfare obsolete. He fights brilliantly but the world has moved on, and a sword cannot stop a cannon.

perk.name: Last condottiere
perk.description: Military cannot drop below 40 — born warrior

downside.name: Lives by the sword
downside.description: Wealth, influence, and church gains all halved — war is all he knows

characters.name: Piero de' Medici
characters.title: The Unfortunate
characters.description: Lorenzo's son, who inherited the Medici name but none of his father's genius. He surrendered Florence's fortresses to the French without a fight and was exiled for his cowardice. The name opens doors — but he closes them behind himself.

perk.name: Medici name
perk.description: Starts with the Medici network: +5 to all stats on round 1

downside.name: The Unfortunate
downside.description: Luck rolls of 2-4 trigger double penalties — history's unluckiest man

deathTriggers.ceilingDeath: Any stat >= 90 triggers assassination or coalition against you
deathTriggers.floorExile: Any stat <= 10 triggers exile or total collapse
deathTriggers.multiDanger: 2+ stats in warning zones triggers an escalating crisis event
